query: What pre-registered attrition thresholds and associated diagnostics (wave-by-wave bias checks) should trigger intensified retention or administrative linkage?

response.query: What pre-registered attrition thresholds and associated diagnostics (wave-by-wave bias checks) should trigger intensified retention or administrative linkage?
response.answer: Pre-registered attrition thresholds triggering intensified retention are typically set at 10% or more wave-to-wave decline; diagnostics include wave-by-wave bias checks. Administrative linkage is considered when attrition exceeds 15%.
